description: Four-year single-cell point-sampling baseline for the Trekker Rim parcel (Ada County parcel R0541500060, City of Boise Parks & Rec, 5.232 acres; centroid 43.55595N, -116.131577E), Boise, Idaho. Supersedes the stale na-sample:1deg:p040.00:m105.00 Denver-point evidence for this entity; the 1-degree North America lattice has no sample cell covering this centroid (it falls in the p043/p044 gap), so this plan defines one explicit boise-local NASA POWER 0.5-degree grid cell. ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN is excluded: the satellite-derived radiation product carries a multi-month processing lag (empirically complete only through 2026-04-30) and the plan's all-or-nothing coverage gate would otherwise reject the entire window; the seven retained parameters were empirically complete through 2026-07-23 at authoring. Sampling areas support regional coverage accounting only and must not be represented as native pixels, field, or acre observations.
